points.description: Resolution (LSB) found from a written formula LSB = V_FS / 2^N with substitution 5 V / 2^12 (or 4095), giving about 1.22 mV (1.2207 mV; 1.2210 mV from 4095 also accepted). Must show the formula/substitution; a bare 1.22 mV with no formula earns 0. If a different range (e.g. 10 V or ±5 V) is used, award this mark only if the arithmetic matches the stated range, and flag it.

levels.says: Formula or substitution written correctly (V_FS / 2^N with N = 12) but arithmetic result for LSB is wrong or missing.

points.description: Divides the LSB voltage by the sensitivity (1.22 mV / 10 mV/N) to get the smallest resolvable force change. Multiplying by the sensitivity earns 0 here. The division must be shown. Final answer about 0.122 N (0.1221 N); give the unit in N.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the LSB from a written V_FS/2^N (2 marks) and division by the sensitivity to give about 0.122 N (1 mark). Using 4095 instead of 4096 is accepted in full. Multiplying by the sensitivity loses the last mark. A bare 1.22 mV with no formula earns no LSB marks. A wrong voltage range earns the LSB marks only if the arithmetic matches that range, and the marker should flag it.
rubric.answer_key: LSB = V_FS / 2^N = 5 V / 4096 = 1.2207 mV. Smallest resolvable force change = LSB / sensitivity = 1.2207 mV / (10 mV/N) = 0.1221 N.
